consent.title: Before you begin
consent.ageLine: This service is intended for users aged {{age}} and older. Please confirm you meet the minimum age of use in your region.
consent.agreeLine: By continuing, you confirm you have read and agree to:
consent.declineHint: If you are under {{age}}, please do not continue.

takedown.title: Report this public letter
takedown.intro: If this public letter defames you, exposes your privacy, or harasses you, submit a takedown request here. No login required — we record and act on it.
takedown.detailsPlaceholder: Details (optional): how does this letter concern you?
takedown.contactPlaceholder: Contact (optional, so we can update you)
takedown.done: We've received your request and will act on it soon.

takedownQueue.title: Takedown requests ({{count}})
takedownQueue.desc: A third party requested removal of one of your public letters. Review, then resolve: 'Actioned' means you've deleted or unpublished it.

app.title: Nameless Letters
app.tagline: Get your own link and collect every anonymous letter.

cover.title: Nameless Letters
cover.subtitle: Every letter is something someone wrote to you, anonymously.
cover.enter: Tap anywhere to open my letterbox

inbox.signedOutDesc: Sign in to get your own link. Anyone can write you an anonymous letter, and you read and reply to them all here.
inbox.shareHint: Share it — anyone can write you an anonymous letter
inbox.empty: No letters yet. Share your link and wait for the first one ✨
inbox.deleteConfirm: This can't be undone. Delete this letter and its conversation?
inbox.mutedHint: They can no longer reply in this thread
inbox.sealedHint: Tap to unseal · hold to peek
inbox.pendingDesc: These letters were flagged as suspicious and are held here for you to confirm. They enter the inbox only after you approve.
inbox.closeBoxHint: Turn on when you're being harassed — no one can write to you; reopen anytime.
inbox.moderationHint: Suspicious letters always go to review; switch to all and every new letter waits for your approval.
inbox.shareHint2: Once shared, anyone can see this letter on your public letterbox
inbox.loginPrompt: Sign in to get your own letterbox link
promptTemplates: Write me anything, seen or unseen.

visitor.heading: Write them a nameless letter
visitor.anonymousNote: Fully anonymous — they'll never know it's you
visitor.placeholder: Write what you want to say…
visitor.sentDesc: Save the receipt link below and come back later to see if they replied.
visitor.wallEmpty: No public letters yet. Be the first to write one.
visitor.notFound: This letterbox doesn't exist or has been closed.
visitor.myLettersDesc: Letters you sent from this device — open one to see replies and keep chatting.
visitor.blockedContent: This may contain hurtful or abusive language. Try rephrasing before you send.
visitor.rateLimited: You're sending too fast. Please try again shortly.
visitor.sendFailed: Couldn't send. Please try again later.
visitor.boxClosed: This inbox is temporarily closed. The owner will reopen it later.
visitor.pendingSent: Delivered — waiting for the owner to review it into their inbox.

receipt.title: Your nameless letter
receipt.waiting: No reply yet — check back later 🌱
receipt.notFound: This receipt can't be found. Please check your receipt link.
receipt.followupHint: You can keep asking anonymously — they'll see it in their letterbox.
receipt.saveLink: Keep this receipt link so you can come back and keep chatting.
receipt.closed: They've closed follow-ups on this conversation.
receipt.blockedContent: This may contain hurtful or abusive language. Try rephrasing.
receipt.rateLimited: You're sending too fast. Please try again shortly.
receipt.sendFailed: Couldn't send. Please try again later.
receipt.reported: Reported. Thank you for flagging it.

safety.screeningNote: This app uses basic keyword filtering (not AI moderation) and may not catch everything.
safety.crisisTitle: If you're going through a hard time
safety.crisisBody: If you're thinking about harming yourself, please reach out to someone nearby or a helpline right now. You are not alone.
safety.crisisHotlineIntl: For emergencies elsewhere, call your local emergency number.
